title: Engram capability records are last-writer-wins: an older overlapping bind/status reply can overwrite a newer one
outcome: In EngramHostAdapter::request (src/engram_host_adapter.rs ~2531, w-decd61d62831's capability recording), each capability record carries a per-session monotonic call sequence taken before the call, and a reply from an older call never overwrites a newer record. Today, two overlapping bind/status calls on the same session under the same child generation can leave a stale NotRead/EntryMissing record (or an older token's answer) in place until the next status read. That keeps a verification record pending longer than needed, though it never sends wrongly, because a send needs both the token and the generation to match. A test with overlapping calls completing out of order proves it. Provenance: w-decd review round 5 Low (Claude delegation 183f089a).
acceptance: Engram capability records are last-writer-wins: an older overlapping bind/status reply can overwrite a newer one is done
